bodyHtml:
Exterior Painting Portfolio

Residential Exterior Projects | The Proud Paintbrush

Our exterior painting portfolio highlights completed projects that showcase durable finishes, consistent preparation, and attention to detail across a wide range of exterior surfaces.

These examples help homeowners see how our exterior work improves curb appeal while protecting homes from weather, moisture, and long-term wear.

Exterior Painting Projects

Below are examples of exterior painting projects completed by The Proud Paintbrush, including:

  • Full exterior repaints

  • Stucco, brick, and siding painting

  • Limewash brick finishes

  • Garage doors and exterior trim

  • Fence and deck staining

  • Patio ceilings and outdoor living spaces

Each project reflects our focus on surface preparation, proper product selection, and clean execution.

What You’ll Notice in Our Exterior Work

As you browse our exterior portfolio, pay attention to:

  • Even coverage and consistent color

  • Clean lines on trim and architectural details

  • Proper preparation on stucco, brick, and siding

  • Finishes designed to hold up to sun and moisture

  • A cohesive, finished look across the entire exterior

These details are what allow exterior paint to perform well over time instead of failing prematurely.

Looking for More Details About Exterior Painting?

If you’d like to learn more about our exterior painting process, materials, or what to expect during a project, you can explore the page below.

→ Explore Exterior Painting Services

Exterior Portfolio FAQs

What types of exterior projects are shown in this portfolio?
This portfolio includes full-home exteriors, stucco and brick painting, limewash finishes, fences, decks, garage doors, and exterior trim.

Do you include before-and-after photos?
Yes. Many exterior projects include before-and-after images to show the transformation and overall impact.

Are these photos from real projects?
Yes. All images shown are from completed exterior painting projects handled by The Proud Paintbrush.

Single-story home exterior repaint with refreshed wall colors and trim, creating a clean, cohesive appearance and improved curb appeal.
Modern stone and stucco home exterior featuring a crisp light finish paired with dark trim and garage doors for strong contrast and definition.
Side yard exterior refresh including fence staining and surface detailing, improving durability and creating a clean, finished look along the property line
Two-story brick home with a full exterior repaint, featuring light wall finishes, dark accents, and clean trim lines for a balanced, modern appearance.
Rear exterior repaint of a two-story home, including walls and trim around patio and pool areas, delivering a cohesive finish designed to withstand moisture and sun exposure.
